description: Copy a photo, video or audio file from a public https link (Dropbox, Drive direct-download, a CDN; redirects are followed) into the workspace, up to 1 GiB. Type and size are read from the link; pass them only if the link doesn't say. Small files come back ready; big ones answer uploading, so check media_get until ready or failed (with the reason).

content_type.description: Only if the link serves a generic type such as application/octet-stream and the file name has no extension.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

name.description: File name to show in the library. Defaults to the link's file name.

size.description: Bytes. Only if the link doesn't send Content-Length.

url.description: Public https link that serves the file itself, not a web page about it.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: media_import_url
title: Import media from a link
